sharedCardContract.camera: Consistent three-quarter product view with slight downward pitch; show front face plus one meaningful side/top plane so construction reads without rotation.
sharedCardContract.framing: Single physical object/group centered with clear silhouette and breathing room; primary mass should remain readable at 220x220 card scale and support 600x600 detail inspection.
sharedCardContract.lighting: Soft warm upper-left key, gentle cool/pink ambient fill, controlled specular response by material, and a grounded contact/cast shadow; no flat outline-only shading.
sharedCardContract.background: Simple boutique-compatible lilac/pink neutral field with soft depth only; no promotional sheet, text, UI chrome, logos, characters or competing props.
sharedCardContract.materialRule: Material identity must survive card scale: painted/molded hard surfaces show edge bevels and specular rolloff; textiles show seams, nap/compression and soft highlights; metal/glass show restrained reflections.

pilot.name: Plush Stack
pilot.visualSpec: A physically stacked trio of original Cloud Pop plush decor pieces with distinct silhouettes, not recolored blobs: broad cloud cushion base, rounded sleepy plush center, smaller star/cloud accent top. Tier 2 should feel richer than Starter through construction and tactile detail while staying cozy and uncluttered; no branded character likenesses or emoji treatment.
